title: The Perfect First-Timer China Route: 4 Cities by Bullet Train | China Travel Expert
description:
First time in China? You can see four of its biggest highlights in one week — all by high-speed rail.

Start in Beijing, then take the bullet train to Xi'an (about 4–6 hours), on to Chengdu (roughly 3 hours), and finish in Shanghai, which is only about 4.5 hours back to Beijing. That's Xi'an's Terracotta Army, Chengdu's giant pandas, and Shanghai's Bund, strung together on the world's largest high-speed network with barely any backtracking.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book on the official 12306 app — tickets release exactly 14 days before travel, foreigners can register with a passport, and you tap that passport at the gate instead of a paper ticket.

第一次来中国，坐高铁一周玩转北京·西安·成都·上海。
